title: Ate it: white while you choose, blue with a tick once eaten
why: Coach Milan 18 November 19:51: Ate it shows as a blue chip; is it a button or a status? Eaten would need a checkmark, to be selected would be white. 20 November 15:52 to 15:57: also the moment it is really eaten, blue with a small tick on its left; drawn where the eaten meal opens again.

opportunity.from: Coach Milan's own look at the boards and the app, 18 November 2026, 19:51, and 20 November, 15:52.
opportunity.job: At the end of a plate, log what I ate, and later see at a glance that a meal is eaten.
opportunity.kind: Did not understand it: an action looks like a status, and a status is missing where it is true.
opportunity.why_now: The meal model is new (0.3.157), and Ate it is how every plate ends up counted.

problem: At the end of a plate I tap Ate it. Its calendar opens and the button turns blue, with no tick. Blue is the look of a chosen choice, so it reads as eaten, and nothing is eaten yet. Plan it does the same. Then, when I open a meal I ate again, from Today or the Plan, nothing on it says it is eaten.
story: When I log a plate, I want what I still choose to look open and what is done to look done, so that I never wonder whether a meal counts.
now: Ate it and Plan it turn blue while their calendar is open. A meal opened again after Ate it shows its meal and time, and no status.
proposed: Ate it and Plan it stay white while their calendar is open; the chosen meal in the calendar is blue with a tick. A meal I ate, opened again from Today, the Plan or a recipe's log, shows Ate it blue with a small tick on its left, next to its meal and time. It is a status: a tap on it does nothing. After Ate it the app still goes to Today, as now.
looked_at: Keeping the plate open after Ate it, with Ate it blue and ticked there, was weighed. Not chosen: the job ends on Today, where the day's numbers move, and the plate would sit there finished with nothing left to do.
decision: Coach Milan 20 November 15:57: draw both moments. Waits for Go.

ac.title: Ate it stays white while you choose
ac.text: Given a plate with no meal set, when I tap Ate it and its calendar opens, then Ate it has the same white look as before the tap.

ac.title: Plan it stays white while you choose
ac.text: Given the same plate, when I tap Plan it and its calendar opens, then Plan it has the same white look as before the tap.

ac.title: The second tap still closes
ac.text: Given Ate it's calendar is open, when I tap Ate it again, then the calendar closes.

ac.title: Blue with a tick is for the chosen
ac.text: Given the calendar is open with Dinner as the guess, when I look at it, then Dinner's row is blue with a tick, and no button above it is blue.

ac.title: An eaten meal says Ate it
ac.text: Given I ate skyr, oats and a banana as Dinner, when I open it again from Today, then Ate it is blue with a small tick on its left, before Dinner, 18:00, and a tap on it does nothing.

ac.title: The same from the Plan and a recipe
ac.text: Given the same meal, when I open it from the Plan or from a recipe's Every time you ate it, then it shows the same Ate it with its tick.

unchanged: What Save it, Plan it and Ate it do, and that Ate it takes you to Today (or to the Plan for another day).
Today's line under the meal: Eaten, by the plan.
The eaten meal's buttons: Save in My recipes, Put it on the Plate again, Change it, Delete this meal.
Ate it on Did you eat it? for a plate from earlier: it is the main button there, filled blue, and stays so.
checks: Area: the unit tests, the build, a new walkthrough for AC1 to AC6, and the walkthroughs of the Plate's end and of a meal opened again (Today, Plan, a recipe's log). About 15 minutes. No words change, so no German sweep.
short: Ate it: white while you choose, blue with a tick once eaten
rel: Redrawn; not agreed until Coach Milan says Go
boardTitle: B151: Ate it is white while you choose, and blue with a tick once the meal is eaten
details: The pictures are the real app on Sunday 15 November 2026, 18:00 (the walkthroughs' day), from one scratch build of 0.3.170, not committed.
The tick look is the app's chosen look (a pale blue chip with a tick on its left), the same as Dinner's row in the calendar.
An action stays an action: white, a button. A status is never a button.
